quest.description: Deep beneath the barrow fields lies the crypt of a king who gave his name to the hollow dark. His crown still rests upon his bier — bring it back to the light.

0,2.description: A sunken stair descends between leaning barrow-stones, and the air grows still and cold. Somewhere below, the Hollow King lies crowned in the dark.

1,2.description: A vaulted passage lined with empty niches. Dust sifts from the ceiling with every footfall.

1,1.description: An embalming chamber, its stone tables stained black with age.

1,0.description: A collapsed ossuary where bones are heaped to the ceiling. Something glints among them.

1,3.description: A crooked gallery where the wall carvings have been scratched out by clawed hands.

1,4.description: A flooded shrine, ankle-deep in black water that swallows every sound.

2,4.description: A reliquary vault half-sealed by a fallen lintel. Cobwebs drape the alcoves like funeral veils.

2,2.description: The flagstones here are worn smooth and strangely clean. Faint seams outline each slab.

3,2.description: A pillared undercroft where the dark presses close. Cold air moves between the columns like slow breath.

3,1.description: A servant's passage, low and narrow, its walls scored by ancient torch-smoke.

3,0.description: A guard post from a forgotten age; rusted spears still lean in their racks.

4,0.description: A small offering-room. Grave-gifts lie undisturbed on a stone shelf.

4,2.description: The processional way. Faded banners hang in shreds from the vault above.

4,3.description: An antechamber before the royal vault, its threshold carved with warnings in a dead tongue.

4,4.description: The burial vault of the Hollow King. Upon a bier of black stone rests a crown of tarnished silver.

characters.name: Crypt Skeleton
characters.description: A yellowed skeleton in the rags of an embalmer's apron, still shuffling between the stained stone tables.

characters.name: Drowned Skeleton
characters.description: It rises from the black water without a ripple, bones slick with weed, sockets weeping silt.

characters.name: Barrow Skeleton
characters.description: A barrow-warrior's bones in rusted mail, sword-notched and patient, rattling softly between the pillars.

characters.name: Vault Warden
characters.description: The king's last herald, a spectral figure in tattered regalia, bound to bar the vault door forever.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A small vial of red liquid that restores health.

items.name: Grave Blade
items.description: A cold iron blade interred with a king's champion. Its edge has never dulled.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A grave-gift left for the dead, still potent.

items.name: Crown of the Hollow King
items.description: A tarnished silver crown, unnaturally heavy. The dead king's claim to a hollow throne.

objective.description: Descend into the crypt and retrieve the Crown of the Hollow King from his burial vault.
